title: Em-dash in implementer-authored free-text flag sentence violates the global em-dash ban
evidence: client/src/copy.gleam:667: `pub const refcheck_unmoderated_flag: String = "Unmoderated referee text — written by the referee, not reviewed by us."` — and the repo's pinned ruling, client/test/copy_test.gleam:305-308: "/// Global em-dash ban (2026-08-05 user ruling): no em-dash may appear in /// any landlord-facing copy string. Pins the ban durably so a single /// reintroduced dash fails CI instead of shipping." — but `no_em_dash_test` only iterates `copy.toast`/`copy.page` (copy_test.gleam:298-300), so the new panel string ships the banned character. The sentence itself is not in the UX spec (§9.3 gives the posture, not this copy).
detail: User-facing string ships an em-dash the repo's own ruling bans; the existing no_em_dash_test doesn't cover panel copy, so the violation ships unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Rewrite without the em-dash, e.g. "Unmoderated referee text. Written by the referee, not reviewed by us." and extend no_em_dash_test to sweep refcheck_* constants.

title: Em-dashes in implementer-authored mini-timeline nudge labels violate the em-dash ban
evidence: client/src/copy.gleam:844: `pub const refcheck_timeline_nudge_failed: String = "Applicant nudge — couldn't send"` and client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:623: `copy.refcheck_timeline_nudge_skipped <> " — " <> skipped.detail` (renders "Applicant nudge skipped — {detail}"). UX §7.6's timeline shows only "● Applicant asked to nudge   Wed 30 Jul, 10:00" — no em-dash on any nudge step; these two labels are implementer-authored, not spec copy. The `" — "` join in batch_line (line 614) matches §7.6's "Invitation sent — email + SMS" verbatim and is fine.
detail: Two new landlord-visible timeline strings contain em-dashes invented by the implementer; the 2026-08-05 ruling and §10 voice ban them where the spec doesn't ship one.
recommended_fix: Drop the dashes: "Applicant nudge. Couldn't send" and "Applicant nudge skipped. {detail}", then pin the strings in the panel tests.

title: refcheck_off_contacts_label export is unused anywhere
evidence: client/src/copy.gleam:567: `pub const refcheck_off_contacts_label: String = "Referee details"` — repo-wide grep (client/src, client/test, server, docs) finds no reference to `refcheck_off_contacts_label` outside this definition line. The Off-state block (view_off/off_ref_block, reference_panel.gleam:180-240) renders heading, body and chips without it.
detail: Dead export shipped in the panel copy set; the lens asked for orphan code and this is the one. Harmless, but it's copy that will never render.
recommended_fix: Delete the constant (and its doc comment), or render it as the Off-state contact-section label if the design intends it.

title: month_abbr duplicated: copy.gleam private copy of helpers/format.gleam's private month_abbr
evidence: client/src/copy.gleam:778: `fn month_abbr(month: String) -> String {` with arms `"01" -> "Jan" ... "12" -> "Dec"` — identical to client/src/helpers/format.gleam:155: `fn month_abbr(month: String) -> String {` (same 12 arms, same `_ -> month` fallback). format.gleam's header declares itself the "single source of truth for rent, number, and date formatting across all client pages and components" (format.gleam:1-3), and refcheck_month_year (copy.gleam:767-775) re-implements month-year formatting instead of reusing it.
detail: Two identical month-abbreviation maps now exist; a future month-label change must be made in both or the panel and date formatters diverge.
recommended_fix: Expose month_abbr (or a format_month_year) from helpers/format.gleam and call it from copy.refcheck_month_year; delete the private copy.

title: relationship_other never rendered despite comment claiming it renders with its parent row
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:808-810: "The canonical per-slot verification field order (result.gleam's §5.3 + A9 per-slot variants, minus `relationship_other` — a companion field that renders with its parent \"Other\" row, never as a standalone question)." But the render path (view_parsed_summary, lines 684-697) maps only slot_field_keys entries to rows, and no code path renders relationship_other: grep shows it only in the comment. Server result.gleam:170-172 emits `#("relationship_other", str_or_null(draft, "relationship_other"))` for both landlord and employer slots. A referee answering "Other" yields a key-facts row "Relationship → Other" with the referee's explanation silently dropped.
detail: The comment (and the implementation spec's dev note) promise the companion text renders with the "Other" row; it doesn't, so the landlord loses the referee's stated relationship explanation.
recommended_fix: Either render relationship_other's text beside the "Other" value in the Relationship row, or correct the comment and spec note to say the companion value is intentionally not displayed.

title: Em-dash in implementer-authored unmoderated-flag sentence (RT CI ban)
evidence: client/src/copy.gleam:667: `pub const refcheck_unmoderated_flag: String = "Unmoderated referee text — written by the referee, not reviewed by us."` and reference_panel.gleam:748: `html.text(copy.refcheck_unmoderated_flag),`
detail: The UX spec (ux-reference-checking-v1-2026-07-29.md) contains no "Unmoderated referee text" sentence (grep of the spec finds it only in architecture/epics docs), so this is implementer-authored copy whose em-dash violates the RT ban: no em-dashes in user-facing copy.
recommended_fix: Rewrite without the em-dash, e.g. "Unmoderated referee text. Written by the referee, not reviewed by us."

title: Em-dash in implementer-authored timeline label (RT CI ban)
evidence: client/src/copy.gleam:844: `pub const refcheck_timeline_nudge_failed: String = "Applicant nudge — couldn't send"` and reference_panel.gleam:624: `Error(_) -> copy.refcheck_timeline_nudge_failed`
detail: §7.6's timeline shows only "Applicant asked to nudge"; the failed-nudge label is implementer-authored and ships an em-dash, violating the RT ban on em-dashes in user-facing copy (timeline labels named as a defect class in the round brief).
recommended_fix: Drop the em-dash: "Applicant nudge couldn't send" (or "Applicant nudge failed to send").

title: month_abbr duplicated byte-for-byte in copy.gleam and helpers/format.gleam
evidence: copy.gleam:778: `fn month_abbr(month: String) -> String { case month { "01" -> "Jan" ... "12" -> "Dec" _ -> month } }` and format.gleam:155: `fn month_abbr(month: String) -> String { case month { "01" -> "Jan" ... "12" -> "Dec" _ -> month } }` — identical private functions; copy.gleam's serves refcheck_month_year (line 773), format.gleam's serves format_timestamp_short (line 147).
detail: The PR adds a second private copy of an existing helper instead of reusing it; AGENTS.md mandates extracting helpers when logic repeats 2+ places, and the copies can silently diverge.
recommended_fix: Export month_abbr from helpers/format.gleam and have copy.refcheck_month_year call format.month_abbr; delete the copy.gleam duplicate.
